proof:
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
  change ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], 3 ≤ N → 3 ∣ N → M7.RecipeSignature.signature (M8.P3Family.recipe N) = M8.P3Family.polynomial
  intro N inst hN hdiv
  have hl := M8.P3Family.literal_polynomial N hN
  have hd := M8.P3Family.divides_modulus N hdiv
  have hp : M8.P3Family.polynomial.Monic := by
    unfold M8.P3Family.polynomial
    apply Polynomial.monic_of_natDegree_le_of_coeff_eq_one 2
    · compute_degree! <;> norm_num
    · norm_num [Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
  have hg : ∀ q : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial, M8.P3Family.polynomial ∣ q → gcd M8.P3Family.polynomial q = M8.P3Family.polynomial := by
    intro q hq
    calc
      gcd M8.P3Family.polynomial q = normalize M8.P3Family.polynomial :=
        gcd_eq_normalize (gcd_dvd_left _ _) (dvd_gcd dvd_rfl hq)
      _ = M8.P3Family.polynomial := hp.normalize
  have hpp := hg M8.P3Family.polynomial dvd_rfl
  have hpm := hg (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) hd
  have hmp : gcd (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) M8.P3Family.polynomial = M8.P3Family.polynomial := by
    rw [gcd_comm, hpm]
  first
  | change gcd (gcd (M7.Supports.polynomial (M8.P3Family.support N)) (M7.Supports.polynomial (M8.P3Family.support N))) (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) = _
  | change gcd (M7.Supports.polynomial (M8.P3Family.support N)) (gcd (M7.Supports.polynomial (M8.P3Family.support N)) (M6.Cyclic.modulus N)) = _
  | change gcd (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) (gcd (M7.Supports.polynomial (M8.P3Family.support N)) (M7.Supports.polynomial (M8.P3Family.support N))) = _
  simp only [hl, hpp, hpm, hmp]
